层次与深度
Outlined
Depth is communicated through outlined, border contrast, and reusable shadow or blur treatments. Keep those recipes consistent across hero panels, cards, and controls so the page reads as one material system.
Surfaces should read as outlined first, with borders, shadows, and blur only reinforcing that material choice.
技法
复制技法
渐变边框外壳
Use a thin gradient border shell around the main card. Wrap the surface in an outer shell with 1px padding and a 16px radius. Drive the shell with linear-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)) so the edge reads like premium depth instead of a flat stroke. Keep the actual stroke understated so the gradient shell remains the hero edge treatment. Inset the real content surface inside the wrapper with a slightly smaller radius so the gradient only appears as a hairline frame.

规范与禁忌
遵循这些约束，可让后续生成保持与当前体系一致，避免漂移到相邻风格。
建议
• 以主色盘作为强调与操作状态的主要点缀色。
• 间距需对齐检测到的 4px 节奏。
• reuse the Outlined surface treatment consistently across cards and controls.
• keep corner radii within the detected 12px, 16px, 9999px family.
避免
• 除非页面需要新的语义状态，否则不要引入核心色盘角色之外的额外点缀色。
• 不要exceed the detected expressive motion intensity without a deliberate reason.
动效
动效偏表现型，但仍聚焦界面、文字与布局过渡。 时序主要聚集在 500ms 与 700ms。 缓动偏好 Cubic 0.4, 0, 0.2, 1 与 Ease。 悬停行为侧重 颜色 与 Text 变化。 滚动编排采用 GSAP ScrollTrigger 控制区块显现与节奏。

WebGL
三维引擎 + WebGL
Reconstruct the graphics as a full-bleed background field using webgl, renderer, alpha, antialias, DPR 限制. The effect should read as retro-futurist, technical, and meditative: perspective grid field with green on black and sparse spacing. Build it from grid lines + depth fade so the effect reads clearly. Animate it as slow breathing pulse. Interaction can react to the pointer, but only as a subtle drift. Preserve dom fallback.

三维引擎
三维引擎 + WebGL
Reconstruct the 三维引擎 layer as a full-bleed background field 与层叠空间纵深 that feels retro-futurist, volumetric, and technical. Use alpha, antialias, DPR 限制 renderer settings, perspective, ~75deg fov, 平面 + 自定义缓冲几何 geometry, pointsmaterial + meshbasicmaterial materials, and 环境光 + 主光 + 轮廓光 lighting. Motion should read as timeline-led reveals, with poster frame + dom fallback.
